tools.name: create_song
tools.description:
Queues a song with real vocals to YOUR finished lyrics and immediately returns a link to its page with two versions to choose from. The song itself is usually ready in 15–60 seconds.
LANGUAGE: write the lyrics in the language the person speaks to you (or asks for) and pass its ISO code in `language`

tools.name: song_status
tools.description: Song status by song_id from create_song: queued — waiting in line, singing — being sung, ready — the versions are done (audio links included), failed — it didn't work (reason in message; failed songs aren't counted). Call at most once every 10 seconds. The page link works before the song is ready to

tools.name: feedback_add
tools.description: FEEDBACK ABOUT THIS SERVER ITSELF, not about a song. Call it when a tool behaved differently from its description, when a parameter or response field was missing, or when a refusal came without a clear reason. Be specific: the tool, what you called, what you expected, what you got — a human reads it

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_song" is 1808 chars, far longer than this server's median (302). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
